summary: The change updates the agent-facing MCP resource guidance in the docs generator, AGENTS.md, and the regenerated docs-auth page, and adds artifact tests. The guide now states the resource is the absolute <origin>/mcp URL for device authorization, token exchange, and refresh, matching the server checks in main.ts.

evidence: scripts/api_docs_generate.ts docsAuthPage now instructs readers to use the absolute MCP resource <origin>/mcp for /oauth/device_authorization and the same absolute resource for /oauth/token.
public/docs-auth.html matches the generator template byte for byte, so the regenerated /docs/auth artifact carries the corrected guidance.
AGENTS.md now states the same absolute MCP resource requirement, including refresh requests, and public/openapi.json is unaffected because the guide prose is not part of the OpenAPI document.
tests/api-docs-artifacts.test.ts pins the corrected wording for device authorization, token exchange, and refresh.
